title: Trump claims ‘roaring’ economy but these Americans aren’t feeling it
summary: Short voter-reaction clip: grocery, utility and gas costs up, and aggregate GDP and stock gains not reflecting lower-income households.

assertions.quote: you can't just say, "Oh, GDP is going up. Oh, the stock market's going up. Everyone's doing great."
the billionaires are doing great as always, but not the people who are making in the lower quintile

verdicts.note: Spending and wealth gains have been concentrated in high-income households holding assets, while lower-income households report strain; the split is real but not a uniform decline for the lower 80%.
